system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; a fixed reasoning prompt P_reasoning plus the question. The mechanism is not described.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: either performing a S EARCH —by formulating a sub-query with explicit temporal constraints to retrieve relevant facts from the temporal knowledge graph
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Reasoning and Answer Generation
env_context_strategy.note: The agent issues SEARCH actions, and the search backend uses SBERT embedding retrieval over the TKG. The embedding_rag behaviour sits inside the tool.

observation_format.note: Observations are retrieved facts rendered as text.

tool_call_format.note: ReAct text actions of the form Search(query, type, time) are parsed from text. The closest value is xml_tags; the exact format is not tag-based.

tool_count.evidence_quote: the agent selects an appropriate action: either performing a S EARCH
tool_count.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Reasoning and Answer Generation
tool_count.note: The two actions are SEARCH and FINISH.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: either performing a S EARCH —by formulating a sub-query with explicit temporal constraints to retrieve relevant facts from the temporal knowledge graph—or initiating a F INISH op-
edit_primitive.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Reasoning and Answer Generation
edit_primitive.note: The action set has no editing tool.

tool_schema_source.note: Actions are described in the prompt.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: An I NVALID verdict triggers a refinement loop, incrementing an attempt counter and prompting iterative re- sponse refinement based on explicit feedback.
loop_primitives.note: A ReAct inner loop runs inside an outer verify-and-refine loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: it formulates a reasoning trace (thought) guided by both the input question and the current state of its internal memory.
planning_granularity.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Reasoning and Answer Generation

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a reasoning agent and a validation module
multi_agent_topology.note: One agent plus an LLM verifier prompt.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a reasoning agent and a validation module

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The agent maintains an internal dialogue memory composed of thought–action–observation triples.
short_term_state.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Reasoning and Answer Generation

self_verification.evidence_quote: the valida- tion module—implemented as an LLM prompt acting as a critic—evaluates the candidate’s correctness.
self_verification.note: It may be the same backbone model; it is coded llm_judge because it is a separate verification call.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: supporting our choice to set the iteration count at N = 2

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This iterative ReAct reasoning cycle continues, pro- gressively refining the agent’s internal understanding and aligning closely with factual evidence, until a FINISH action is triggered.
termination_condition.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Reasoning and Answer Generation
termination_condition.note: max_steps refers to the cap of N verification attempts.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on MultiTQ and CronQuestions. The repo was not inspected.

target_domain.evidence_quote: TKGQA is the task of answering questions using facts stored in TKGs
target_domain.note: The domain is temporal KG question answering. It is not a clean fit; research was chosen as the closest value, and other is also possible.

open_source.note: A repo URL is given, but no license was seen.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we evaluate SAR across multiple backbones, including OpenAI’s GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4.1, as well as the open- source, 70B-parameter Llama3-Instruct.
